findings.title: Missing Security Header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS in web server response headers (e.g. Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains).

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header to prevent XSS and data injection attacks.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin to limit referrer leakage.

findings.title: Exposed API Documentation
findings.description: Publicly accessible OpenAPI / Swagger documentation. Found at http://localhost:3000/api-docs
findings.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated access to '/api-docs' endpoint if not intended for public access.

findings.title: Exposed Swagger UI
findings.description: Public Swagger UI endpoint. Found at http://localhost:3000/swagger-ui
findings.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated access to '/swagger-ui' endpoint if not intended for public access.

findings.title: Exposed FTP Directory
findings.description: Publicly accessible FTP directory/file browser. Found at http://localhost:3000/ftp
findings.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated access to '/ftp' endpoint if not intended for public access.

findings.title: Exposed Git Repository
findings.description: Exposed .git directory allows source code download. Found at http://localhost:3000/.git/HEAD
findings.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated access to '/.git/HEAD' endpoint if not intended for public access.

findings.title: Exposed Metrics Endpoint
findings.description: Exposed Prometheus/application metrics endpoint. Found at http://localhost:3000/metrics
findings.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated access to '/metrics' endpoint if not intended for public access.

findings.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability in Product Search
findings.description: The 'q' parameter in '/rest/products/search' is vulnerable to SQL injection. Unsanitized input allows manipulating backend database queries.
findings.evidence: Payload '' OR '1'='1' produced HTTP 200 response containing database output/error.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements (ORM parameter binding) instead of dynamic string concatenation.

findings.title: Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection on Login
findings.description: The login endpoint '/rest/user/login' is vulnerable to SQL injection authentication bypass. Crafted input in the email field allows logging in without valid credentials.
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 OK with valid authentication token returned for SQLi payload.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries for user authentication lookups.
